title: The Real Reason CD Laser Wavelength Matters

scenes.text: CD players read data using a laser exactly 780 nanometers long
Many assume any red laser can read a CD as long as it’s bright enough.
scenes.label: Any red laser myth
scenes.query: any red laser CD reading myth

scenes.text: The 780 nm wavelength matches the reflectivity of the CD’s aluminum layer, allowing precise focus and error correction; other wavelengths cause scattering and data loss.
scenes.label: Specific wavelength needed

scenes.text: Exact wavelength ensures reliable data retrieval across all discs.
scenes.label: Precision matters
scenes.sub: A tiny shift breaks reading accuracy.
